title: 나란히 1위
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with soft rock influences. Clean electric guitar plays arpeggiated chords with light chorus and delay. A warm synth bass follows the root notes of the progression. Drums feature a crisp snare with moderate reverb and a soft kick drum. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, breathy tenor register, transitioning into a more resonant chest voice during the build-up. The arrangement is mid-tempo at 74 BPM in the key of E Major. The production is polished with a wide stereo field for the vocal harmonies and a subtle string pad providing harmonic density in the background.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[arpeggiated clean electric guitar with chorus, soft synth pad]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
형광등이 떨리고 있다
대기실 거울 속 두 얼굴
인이어에선 숨소리 세고 [bass enters]
심장이 박자를 놓치고 있다
이 소파에 나란히 앉아
말이 없어도 안다
지금 둘 다 같은 곳을 본다
[snare hit with reverb]
실검에 이름이 떴다
